response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with strong software craftsmanship, but the role requires deep hardware-oriented expertise — SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU/SIMD architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. Aside from some low-latency backend work in DLang and brief C/C++ tooling experience, there is no evidence of computer architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or performance modeling for silicon, making this a fundamental domain mismatch for a Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the years-of-experience bar
Some systems-level exposure: low-latency DLang services, async I/O, C/C++ components
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source/community contributions
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware design experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Long tenure and solid general software engineering skills
